description: This file defines API routes for managing data assets in a data insights dashboard. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, validating, and approving data assets, along with associated documentation comments and imported service dependencies.

methods.name: create_data_asset( request: CreateDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new data asset with standardized metadata, triggers validation, and requires authentication.

methods.name: get_data_asset( data_asset_id: str, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve details of a specific data asset, including latest validation status.

methods.name: trigger_validation( data_asset_id: str, request: TriggerValidationRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to trigger a validation run for a specified data asset.

methods.name: approve_data_asset( data_asset_id: str, request: ApproveDataAssetRequest, current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to approve or reject a data asset with electronic signature and Segregation of Duties validation.
